counterfactual_missing_items: Absence of significant cytologic atypia in endothelial cells
Specific histopathological features of other candidates not mentioned
decisive_items: Thin-walled, irregularly branched blood vessels dispersed between thickened collagen bundles
Endothelial cells were plump but displayed no significant cytologic atypia
response.rationale: The champion candidate, C1 (Hemangioma, capillary), is supported by the most comprehensive set of histopathological findings, including thin-walled, irregularly branched blood vessels, plump endothelial cells, and positive immunohistochemistry results for CD31, CD34, and low Ki-67. The runner-up candidate, R6 (Hemangioma), is also supported by some of these findings, but lacks specific details on the histopathological features. The other candidates, R3 (Arteriovenous malformation) and R1 (Angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia), are less well-supported by the provided information.

rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathological features supporting arteriovenous malformation
Insufficient histopathological evidence to support angiolymphoid hyperplasia with eosinophilia
